description: Terrain traversability configuration. Every value is a pipeline input with provenance; none are verified Project Reality v1.9 facts unless the provenance says so.

cell_size_m.provenance: design target simulation resolution (flow design D6)

roughness_window_m.provenance: feature-scale default, about road width; design D3 rejects map-width-relative windows

roughness_multiplier_enabled.provenance: design D3: roughness is recorded first; a cost multiplier applies only after QA policy approves

roughness_ref_m.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; roughness at this level reaches roughness_max multiplier

smooth_slope_deg.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; diagnostic class threshold only

smooth_roughness_m.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; diagnostic class threshold only

flat_epsilon_deg.provenance: uncalibrated default; candidate inland water flatness test (design D6)

candidate_min_area_m2.provenance: uncalibrated default; candidate inland water minimum region area (design D6)

basin_margin_m.provenance: uncalibrated default; candidate region must sit this far below its border ring mean, so noise-flat plains are not flagged

building.provenance: uncalibrated default; fixed-radius proxy, no collision meshes (known ceiling)

wall.provenance: uncalibrated default; fixed-radius proxy, no collision meshes (known ceiling)

fence.provenance: uncalibrated default; fixed-radius proxy, no collision meshes (known ceiling)

container.provenance: uncalibrated default; fixed-radius proxy, no collision meshes (known ceiling)

density_radius_m.provenance: uncalibrated default; plants are counted within this radius per cell (flow design D2 density proxy)

dense_count.provenance: uncalibrated default; cells at or above this count within density_radius_m are the slow forest tier

max_slope_deg.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; only default hard-block condition (D5/D7)

slope_full_penalty_deg.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value

step_max_m.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; blurred at 2-4 m source resolution

max_slope_deg.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; only default hard-block condition (D5/D7)

slope_full_penalty_deg.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value

step_max_m.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; blurred at 2-4 m source resolution

water.provenance: uncalibrated default; heavy cost, never impassable (flow design D7)

water_candidate.provenance: design D6: candidate inland water is diagnostic-only by default; raise only after QA review approves (flat basins are not always water)

building.provenance: uncalibrated default; heavy cost, never impassable (flow design D7)

vegetation_dense.provenance: uncalibrated default; density proxy per flow design D2

road.provenance: uniform-surface default per flow design D3 (forum claim unverified); road bonus stays off until verified

roughness_max.provenance: uncalibrated default; inert while grid.roughness_multiplier_enabled is 0

slope_max.provenance: uncalibrated default, no verified v1.9 value; slope cost ramps to this at slope_full_penalty_deg

materials.provenance: extracted from v1.9 files, speed effect unverified
